newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - European stocks lead New Yorks ADRs.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - European stocks lead New Yorks ADRs.

text.p: Foreign stocks were highlighted on Wednesday by trade in such big European companies as Hanson Plc, analysts said.
American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) for Latin American stocks were largely flat as investors shrugged off the Federal Reserve's decision on Tuesday not to raise interest rates.
Investors "still see an interest rate rise to come," said Geoffrey Dennis, Latin American strategist for Bear Stearns. "We're looking for something else to move the market."
Latin American stocks were headed by Mexico's Grupo Radio Centro, which rose 3/4 to 8-3/8.
Brazilian state telecommunications company Telebras was off 1/4 to 80-1/8 despite reporting strong eight-month revenues on Tuesday.
Hanson was off 1/4 to 12 on trade of 2.5 million shares on news that when-issued shares of Hanson unit Millennium Chemicals fell in London trade. The unit is to be spun off from Hanson in October.
British Steel rose 5/8 to 29-3/4 in the wake of a weak earnings report from French rival Usinor Sacilor SA.
Among other stocks, the Netherlands' Philips Electronics NV rose 7/8 to 37.
